figurative_meaning_en: Lord of religion and the world - God
example_sentences_in_bangla: দীন দুনিয়ার মালিক, আমাদের দুঃখ দূর করুন।
ভক্তরা দীন দুনিয়ার মালিকের নামে প্রার্থনা করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: O Lord of the humble world, remove our sorrows.
Devotees pray in the name of the Lord of the humble world.
history: This phrase originates from Bengali devotional songs and poetry, often used in contexts of humility and divine appeal, possibly influenced by Vaishnava or Baul traditions.
note: The idiom is frequently invoked in prayers to emphasize God's compassion towards the meek and worldly afflicted.
